name: space-power-transmitter
title: Space Power Transmitter
author: versuffer
description: Links any planet or space platform (even a moving one) to a shared space power grid: energy flows both ways over any distance, rationed by demand. Holding the link costs a constant upkeep (600 MW by default, less at higher quality); without enough local power the link drops and reconnects automatically. Wired to a circuit network, the transmitter broadcasts its link status and supports an Enable if condition. Can be unlocked on Aquilo.
